newsitem.title: INDIA: India 96/97 exports up 4.01 pct to $33.1 bln.
newsitem.headline: India 96/97 exports up 4.01 pct to $33.1 bln.

text.p: India's exports during 1996/97 (April-March) are estimated at $33.11 billion, up 4.01 percent from 1995/96, the Commerce Ministry said on Wednesday.
The ministry said imports during 1996/97 rose 5.99 percent to $38.55 billion from $36.37 billion in the previous year.
India's oil imports in 1996/97 were valued at $9.62 billion, up 34.38 percent from $7.16 billion in the previous year, the ministry said.
The trade deficit for 1996/97 was estimated at $5.44 billion against $4.54 billion in 1995/96, the ministry said.
